limits: Canonical declaration/member counts merge overloads and same-named fields of tagged union alternatives.
Signature-support declarations are included conservatively; they are not all standalone imports.
ESM default namespace facades and extension aliases are reviewed as module bindings, not new domain APIs.
Standard-library inherited members and private implementation members are excluded.
Parameters, generics, literals and inherited/mapped members are assessed with their owning contracts; only declared members have standalone rows.
No claim of formally proven human unambiguity; scores estimate likely agent comprehension impact.
